points.note: Estimate: Method describes one Lesser Stone Golem, one Looter and one Summoner before Durgen. Polymorph the Summoner and kill the Looter and Golem first.

strategies.text: Mind Blast and Anvilmar's Curse. The risk is pulling his undead dwarves too: clear a safe spot first.
Fire Nova hits everyone nearby, Combust lands on a random player. Kill the Summoner first; the tank drags Magmatus away.
Only Knock Away. Pull him into a corner away from other packs and keep players out of the knockback path.
Fear for 8 s, Rend on the tank, and two Lesser Stone Golem adds. Kill Dirgehammer fast, then the golems. Clear the Dark Iron Looters before the pull.

notes: Forever-only dungeon: no uiMapID is known, use instanceMapID 3065 and the floor name. Level range is the client's Group Finder table (13-20; NeedRoll shows 13-18). Boss order and mechanics come from Method. Faldrim (Anvilmar's Rest), Magmatus (Dark Iron Ingress) and Durgen (Reliquary of Kings) are estimates from the room names on the map picture; Plunder is not placed (Method: he patrols the hallway between the first two bosses and the last). No NPC IDs: the Forever IDs have no open source. OpenMap's journal calls Magmatus 'Infurnus' in older data. NeedRoll was used only as a cross-check. Quests: An Ancient Grudge and The Treaty of Understanding are obtained inside; Thom Filch, Afadra Dunwall and Earthseer Farsen are outside. The Dark Iron Map (looted from Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh) starts a breadcrumb.
